text:
Type: off-white metal dome pendant lamp
Use: light over a dining table or a kitchen island; dining room, kitchen, living room
Style: industrial, farmhouse, retro
Materials: off-white lacquered steel shade, brass-coloured cage fitting, braided grey and white textile cord, white ceiling cup
Colors: warm off-white, brass gold, grey
Shape: wide shallow dome with a rounded shoulder and a small brass cage at the top, hangs on a long cord, medium-to-large, clean and solid
Feel: warm, nostalgic, homely, crafted
Goes with: wood tables, white tiles, brass or black accents; farmhouse, industrial or Scandinavian kitchens

product.name: RANARP
product.description: Gives a directed light; good for lighting up for example dining tables or bar tops.
